algorithm: Production SolverFactory AdaptiveNewmark, beta=.25 gamma=.5; step doubling commits two half steps, no full-step update identity gate
absolute_tolerance_policy: atol_q=rtol*.01*min(q_Y_scale,q_RZ_scale); atol_v=rtol*.01*min(v_Y_scale,v_RZ_scale). The production solver has one q atol shared by metres/radians and one v atol shared by metres/s/radians/s. These are numerical SI-component scales, not a dimensionally homogeneous vector norm or per-DOF tolerance facility.

bending.normalization: Original frozen q=(A,abs(r)A), v=omega*q, a=omega^2*q; all six full histories. A=1e-7m, abs(r)A approximately7.5011715e-8rad; v scales approximately1.0960656e-5m/s and8.2217762e-6rad/s.
bending.execution: Actual AnalysisStep::Solve(false), actual Node/CR and automatic modal damping preparation. The factory identity probe is checked before Solve; accepted frames and successful production PushStateCheckpoint calls are observed, not a held private solver.
bending.rejection_statistics: Retain successful_checkpoint_pushes and accepted_steps; on complete runs rejected_attempt_estimate=pushes-accepted. Incomplete final attempt may not be a rejected retry; do not claim exact internal TimeStepStatistics.
bending.precision_statistics: Private solver count unavailable through Solve wrapper. JSON count=null and complete stdout/stderr zero newmark_precision_limited events is a required external gate. Absence of output capture cannot be PASS.

nonlinear.execution: Factory-held AdaptiveNewmark on real initialized AnalysisStep/Node/CR, exact accepted/rejected/precision counters. Original physical initial acceleration=M^-1(-grad U).
nonlinear.reference_time_evaluation: Evaluate original frozen finest-grid quintic Hermite q/v at actual accepted time and recompute acceleration=-grad U/M; original independent midpoint consistency gate1e-8 retained. Root additionally evaluates independently rebuilt double DOP853 references at actual times. No row-index or linear-interpolation comparison.

acceptance.trend_scope: For each physical case and each q/v/a group, take the larger of the Y/RZ full-window normalized maxima; each adjacent tolerance tightening must reduce this envelope to at most .9 of previous. Fine six-channel limit remains original .0015. No fixed-step second-order claim for varying accepted times.

limits: Only the declared planar two-DOF CR semidiscrete micro-amplitude and finite-amplitude models are covered; no general spatial or continuum certification.
Adaptive LTE controls q and v; acceleration is independently checked, not silently treated as controlled.
Original fixed Newmark inputs, numerical gates, references, CLI behavior and default GoogleTests remain unchanged.
No candidate state or generated reference has been used to select tolerances or gates.
